findings.title: add validates title, priority and tags twice
findings.why: `add` runs `validateTitle`, `validatePriority` and `validateTag` itself, and then `createTask` repeats all three checks. The early checks do keep invalid input from bumping the id counter. But the duplicated logic could drift, and the `!created.ok` branch can never be taken.

findings.title: Placeholder Purpose left in archived specs
findings.why: The bulk-import, task-identity and task-timestamps specs all keep the generated line 'TBD - created by archiving change …' as their Purpose. The task-input-validation spec has a real one.
